meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描文稿里读起来像机器生成的写作模式，逐条引用问题原文，再给出改写版本。默认是改写模式，也可以只标记不改或直接改文件；改写时不会添加原文没有的第一人称、立场或事实。
howto.when: 当你要求去掉 AI 腔、让文字读起来不像 AI 写的，或要审查 README、changelog、PR 描述等文本时触发。

say.text: 把这篇稿子的 AI 腔去掉
say.note: 默认进入改写模式，返回问题清单和改写版。

say.text: 就地修改 draft.md，只动被标记的地方
say.note: 进入 edit 模式，改后重读文件确认。

howto.what_en: Claude scans prose for machine-sounding patterns, quotes each flagged span, and rewrites it. It also offers detect-only and in-place editing modes, and never adds stance, personality, or facts the source lacked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to remove AI-isms, make text sound less like AI, or audit a README, changelog, PR description, or blog post.

say_en.text: Strip the AI-isms from this draft
say_en.note: Runs default rewrite mode: issues list plus rewritten text.
Runs detect mode, grouped by severity, marking judgment calls.

say_en.text: Edit draft.md in place, only the flagged spots
say_en.note: Runs edit mode, then re-reads the file to confirm.
